mapper.insert: INSERT INTO news (title, content, category_id, user_id, create_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{categoryID}, #{userID}, NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news
title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM news WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = '0') AND (status IS NULL OR status = 0)

SELECT n.id, n.title, n.content, n.like_count, n.comment_count, n.collect_count, n.create_time, (SELECT ni.image_url FROM news_image ni WHERE ni.news_id = n.id ORDER BY ni.sort_order ASC, ni.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS cover FROM news n WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND (n.is_deleted IS NULL OR n.is_deleted = '0') AND (n.status IS NULL OR n.status = 0) ORDER BY n.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
